candidates.title: Dynamic Data Allocation and Task Scheduling on Multiprocessor Systems With NVM-Based SPM
candidates.authors: Yan Wang, Kenli Li, Keqin Li
candidates.method: Combines dynamic task scheduling with data allocation on a hybrid SRAM/NVM scratch-pad memory to reduce multiprocessor memory cost and latency.
candidates.limitations: Memory hierarchy is NVM-based SPM rather than the A题 L1/UB/DDR/FIFO-cache evaluator; use as memory-allocation background, not a direct baseline.

focused_existing.title: A Scalable Clustering-Based Task Scheduler for Homogeneous Processors Using DAG Partitioning
focused_existing.method: Uses an acyclic DAG partitioner to form global clusters, then schedules clusters with list heuristics so locality gains are balanced against parallelism and communication.

focused_existing.title: Efficient Scheduling of Irregular Network Structures on CNN Accelerators
focused_existing.venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems
focused_existing.method: Uses dynamic-programming/node-clustering DAG partitioning for inter-layer reuse, then co-optimizes subgraph order, on-chip memory allocation and loop tiling for fused layers.
